receiptDetail.toastCancelled: Goods receipt cancelled. Stock was returned and the journal reversed.
receiptDetail.errorCancel: Could not cancel the goods receipt.
receiptDetail.cancelledNotice: This goods receipt is cancelled. Stock was returned and the journal reversed.
receiptDetail.legacyNotice: This goods receipt is an automatic backfill from PI {{number}}. The original stock was recorded through the PI in the old flow. To cancel it, cancel the PI.

confirmCancel.title: Cancel goods receipt
confirmCancel.description: Cancel goods receipt {{number}}? Stock will be returned and the journal reversed. This is recorded in the audit trail.

forceCancel.title: Force cancel the goods receipt?
forceCancel.description: {{message}} To force the cancellation (stock may go negative), enter a reason (min 10 characters).

receiptForm.toastFullyReceived: All lines of {{number}} are fully received.
receiptForm.errorLoadPO: Could not load the PO lines. Try selecting it again.
receiptForm.toastSaved: Goods receipt saved. Stock added to the warehouse.
receiptForm.errorSave: Could not save the goods receipt.
receiptForm.errorItems: Add at least one item with qty > 0 and a warehouse.
receiptForm.title: New goods receipt
receiptForm.description: Goods received from a supplier: stock goes up and a payable is recorded.
receiptForm.customerOwnedHint: Goods owned by a customer for reprocessing. Only quantities are recorded, with no inventory value or payable, and they cannot be turned into a Purchase Invoice. Bill the service through a Sales Invoice (service line).
receiptForm.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. truck B 123 ABC, grade A, etc.
receiptForm.costNote: A goods receipt records received quantities only. The actual price is entered when the purchase invoice is created from it. Until then, the item's current average cost is used as a provisional cost.

replaceLines.title: Replace lines with the PO balance?
replaceLines.description: The lines you entered will be replaced with {{count}} outstanding lines from {{number}} (item, remaining qty, unit, destination warehouse). Choose Cancel to keep your lines; the PO stays selected but your lines are not linked to the PO lines.

invoiceForm.toastResubmitted: Request updated and resubmitted for approval.
invoiceForm.toastPendingApproval: Invoice sent for manager approval. It will be processed once approved.
invoiceForm.title: New purchase invoice
invoiceForm.footerOrphan: Raw materials must come through a goods receipt. See the warning above.
invoiceForm.footerIncomplete: Select a supplier and add at least 1 item
invoiceForm.fromReceipts: Create from goods receipts (you can select more than 1)
invoiceForm.noPendingReceipts: No pending goods receipts for this supplier. Create one first under Purchasing → Goods Receipts.
invoiceForm.receiptsSelected: {{count}} goods receipts selected and their items loaded. Fill in the price on each line. This invoice will not add the stock again.
invoiceForm.noFiles: No files yet. Max {{max}} files, 5 MB each (JPG/PNG/PDF).
invoiceForm.otherCostsHint: Can be negative to reduce the bill

orphan.title: Raw materials must come through a goods receipt
orphan.description: Since 20 May 2026, incoming stock must be recorded through a goods receipt. The invoice is the bill only. These items on this invoice are still direct purchases:
orphan.notLinked: : not linked to a goods receipt
orphan.solution: Fix: create a goods receipt first under Purchasing → Goods Receipts, then come back and pick it from the pending goods receipts list above.

variance.title: Save with variances?
variance.description: {{qty}} qty variance lines and {{price}} price variance lines exceed the tolerance against the PO/goods receipt. The invoice can still be saved; price variances are recorded as usual.

errors.supplier: Select a supplier or tick "General PO".
errors.items: Add at least one item with a name and qty > 0.

poForm.itemsTable: PO items table (scroll to see more columns)
poForm.increaseBlocked: Increasing this PO (from {{amount}}) exceeds the approval limit and will be rejected. Lower the amount, or cancel this PO and create a new one to submit again.
poForm.needsApprovalNotice: This PO amount needs approval. Once submitted, the PO is Awaiting approval and becomes Ordered after it is approved.

poDetail.closedNotice: PO closed on {{date}}. The remaining qty is no longer expected.
poDetail.cancelledNotice: This PO is cancelled. Existing goods receipts stay valid (the goods were received).

confirmCancel.title: Cancel PO
confirmCancel.description: Cancel PO {{number}}? Goods receipts already created from this PO stay valid. The PO cannot be reactivated.

confirmDelete.title: Delete draft PO
confirmDelete.description: Delete draft {{number}}? The draft is deleted permanently; this PO number is not reused.

confirmClose.title: Close {{number}}
confirmClose.description: The remaining qty is no longer expected and the PO no longer appears in the PO list when creating a goods receipt. Existing goods receipts stay valid. Closing cannot be undone.
confirmClose.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Supplier cannot fulfil the remaining order
